text: Nia said, “I want to help Mrs Wren.” Tomas told Nia, “I would like to race.” Nia fetched the red sled from the shop. The red sled was stuck. Nia told Tomas, “I need help.” Tomas left the race. Tomas said, “I can help you.” Nia and Tomas freed the red sled. Nia and Tomas cleared the gate. Nia placed the grocery basket on the kitchen table. Nia returned the red sled to the shop. Mrs Wren lit the stove. The stove glowed.
